corrections.reason: BIS public document mirror lists IS 1489 (Part 2): 2015 (Fourth Revision) as the current edition.
'Reaffirmed 2020' belonged to the superseded 1991-edition lineage; amendments of the 2015 edition not yet confirmed from an official source.
Official BIS book/product-manual listings cite 'IS 4984:2016 Polyethylene Pipes for Water Supply - Specification (Fifth Revision)'.
